_comment: FRET line generator, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over FretLineModel (gui/model.py): 'components', 'sweep' and 'lines' are the three tabs of the left window (the Qt tool's Components / Sweep / FRET lines pages), 'actions' the bar under everything (Add FRET line, Save CSV, Push to ndX), 'dialog' the in-app notice the Qt tool showed as message boxes. The model editor and the plots are drawn by gui/app.py (a spec cannot draw them).
title: FRET lines

sections.title: Components
sections.name: components
sections.description: The models that are mixed. Each is an independent live model; the editor on the right edits the selected one.
One row per mixture component: its name, its model and its mixing weight. Select a row to edit that component in the editor.

columns.title: Name
columns.tooltip: C0, C1, ...: the number the sweep targets refer to.

columns.title: Model
columns.tooltip: The model family of the component.

columns.title: Weight
columns.tooltip: The initial mixing weight; the sweep normalises all weights.

sections.description: Add a component to the mixture or remove the selected one.

buttons.label: Add
buttons.description: Append a component with the model of the selected one; it can then be edited independently.

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected component. One component always stays.

sections.label: Model
sections.description: The model of the selected component. Choosing another replaces the component (its weight is kept, its parameters reset to the new model's defaults).

sections.label: Weight
sections.description: Mixing weight of the selected component (normalised across the components).

sections.title: Sweep
sections.name: sweep
sections.description: What to vary, over which range, and the reference lifetime of the efficiency.

sections.label: Filter
sections.description: Keep only the targets whose label contains this text (case-insensitive).

sections.label: Vary
sections.description: The parameter or mixing fraction to vary: C<i> [model] name, or fraction of a component.

sections.label: All parameters
sections.description: Also list the timing, IRF, background and anisotropy parameters and the donor-only fraction, which do not move a FRET line.

sections.label: Min
sections.description: First value of the swept quantity.

sections.label: Max
sections.description: Last value of the swept quantity.

sections.label: log
sections.description: Logarithmic spacing (both ends must be positive).

sections.label: Points
sections.description: Number of evaluated sweep points.

sections.label: τ_D0 (ns)
sections.description: Donor-only lifetime for E = 1 - τ_X/τ_D0. 0 takes it from the first FRET component.

sections.title: FRET lines
sections.name: lines
sections.description: Every computed line. Each press of Add FRET line appends a snapshot; they are overlaid on the plots.
One row per computed line. Tick Show to show or hide a line on the plots; select a row to remove it.

columns.title: Show
columns.tooltip: Tick to show the line on the plots, untick to hide it.

columns.title: Line
columns.tooltip: Line 1, Line 2, ... in the order they were added.

columns.title: Colour
columns.tooltip: The colour of the line on the plots.

sections.description: Show, hide, remove or clear the computed lines.

buttons.label: Hide all
buttons.description: Hide every line (they stay in the list).

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected line (the last one when none is selected).

sections.title: Model parameters
sections.name: editor
sections.description: The parameters of the selected component's model.
Every parameter the selected model uses. Double-click a Value, Lower or Upper cell to type a number (Enter commits, Escape cancels); click a Fixed or Bounds box to flip it.

columns.title: Name
columns.tooltip: The parameter's name in the model.

columns.title: Value
columns.tooltip: The parameter's value; the sweep restores it after every line.

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Hold the parameter constant in a fit (it does not change a FRET line).

columns.title: Bounds
columns.tooltip: Apply the lower and upper limit.

columns.title: Id
columns.tooltip: The canonical parameter id used by the sweep targets and the headless API.

sections.title: Actions
sections.name: actions
sections.description: Compute a line and send the collection away.
Compute the current sweep, save all lines, or push them to ndX.

buttons.label: Add FRET line
buttons.description: Compute the current mixture and sweep and add it as a new line. Press repeatedly to overlay several lines.

buttons.label: Save CSV
buttons.description: Save all computed lines to one CSV file (line, sweep, parameter, τ_F, τ_X, E per point).

buttons.label: Push to ndX
buttons.description: Overlay all computed lines (E vs τ_F) on every open ndX window, as data curves of its Overlays tab; with no ndX window open a notice says so.

sections.description: What the last action did.

sections.title: Notice
sections.name: dialog
sections.description: Reports a computed or saved result or a problem.
What happened.
Close the notice.
